import pandas as pd

def main():
    # Source file path
    source0_path = "autopipeline-benchmarks/github-pipelines/length1_38/test_0.csv"
    # Target output path
    target_path = "autopipeline-benchmarks/github-pipelines/length1_38/target_multisource_cot.csv"

    # Load Source0 data with index_col=0 to ignore the numerical index column
    df0 = pd.read_csv(source0_path, index_col=0)

    # The target schema is: ['user_id': integer, 'sad': float, 'stressed': float]
    # Source0 schema: ['user_id', 'time', 'sore.throat.cough', 'runnynose.congestion.sneezing',
    # 'fever', 'nausea.vomiting.diarrhea', 'sad.depressed', 'open.stressed']

    # Transformation plan:
    # - Group by user_id (primary key in target)
    # - Aggregate sad.depressed and open.stressed by average (float in target)
    # - Cast user_id to int (target type)
    # - Rename columns sad.depressed -> sad, open.stressed -> stressed

    # Group by user_id and aggregate averages of sad.depressed and open.stressed
    agg_df = df0.groupby('user_id', as_index=False).agg({
        'sad.depressed': 'mean',
        'open.stressed': 'mean'
    })

    # Rename columns to target schema
    agg_df.rename(columns={
        'sad.depressed': 'sad',
        'open.stressed': 'stressed'
    }, inplace=True)

    # Cast user_id to integer type (target schema)
    agg_df['user_id'] = agg_df['user_id'].astype(int)

    # Ensure sad and stressed are float (should be by default after mean)
    agg_df['sad'] = agg_df['sad'].astype(float)
    agg_df['stressed'] = agg_df['stressed'].astype(float)

    # Save to target CSV
    agg_df.to_csv(target_path, index=False)

if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()
